title: Standing Down
summary: Brannoc has heard of the legion in the Old Barrows that held its road for three hundred years because nobody told it to stop. He'd like to stand with it once, the way he never stood with anyone.

steps.journal: Go down to the Long Gallery, the Old Barrows' second floor, and hold its last hall for five waves.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Long Gallery's last hall

ready: Tell Brannoc it's done: tap his party card, then Talk.
done: You held the Long Gallery's last hall with Brannoc. He stood; they stood. He gave you his old chain, less one link.
